items.name: ResolveRv2Kdx
items.prompt:
# Target
EVM selector name resolution on carriers Rv2Token (5 functions) and KdxToken (6 functions).
# Work
For each carrier (Rv2Token /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/arc3-loop1-round1/claims/c1/RV-2/Rv2Token.runtime.hex with ABI /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/arc3-loop1-round1/claims/c1/RV-2/Rv2Token.abi.json; KdxToken /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/arc3-loop1-round1/claims/c1/EX-05/kdx-runtime.hex with ABI /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/arc3-loop1-round1/claims/c1/EX-05/kdx-abi.json): (1) run `inspect-evm-interface <runtime.hex> hex --format json` with REA 6.5.0 and keep the envelope; (2) list the recovered selectors; (3) derive the ground-truth text signatures from the retained ABI JSON by keccak256 of the canonical signature (use a verified Keccak-256, not hashlib.sha3_256; /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/arc3-loop1-round1/claims/c1/RV-1/keccak_ref.py is a retained pure-Python reference - test it on transfer(address,uint256)=a9059cbb first); (4) query https://www.4byte.directory/api/v1/signatures/?hex_signature=0x<sel> and https://api.openchain.xyz/signature-database/v1/lookup?function=0x<sel>&filter=false for every selector, saving each raw response with its UTC fetch time and sha256; (5) tabulate per selector: DB hit yes/no per database, number of candidates, whether the ABI name is among them, whether it is the first/only candidate, openchain `filtered` flag of the true name, and keccak check of every returned candidate.
# Acceptance
Report a per-carrier table (selectors recovered, ABI-matching, 4byte hit, openchain hit, true name present, true name ranked first, candidates failing keccak) with totals, every artifact path and sha256, and the exact commands. State the counts as observed at fetch time; databases change.

items.name: CollisionCensus
items.prompt:
# Target
Selector collisions in public signature databases for the 8 standard ERC-20 selectors (totalSupply, balanceOf, transfer, transferFrom, approve, allowance, plus the Transfer/Approval-adjacent decimals and name/symbol if you pick them; name your 8).
# Work
For each selector fetch every candidate from 4byte.directory (follow `next` pagination) and openchain (filter=false), save raw responses with UTC time and sha256, compute keccak256 of every candidate text signature and check its first 4 bytes. Count: candidates per selector per database, candidates whose keccak prefix matches (genuine 32-bit collisions), candidates that do not match (database errors), and how openchain marks them (`filtered`, `hasVerifiedContract`). Note any candidate ordering rule you can observe (4byte returns newest first? check `created_at`).
# Acceptance
Report the per-selector table and totals, the raw files with sha256, and one concrete collision example with its keccak computation shown. Say what ordering rule is observed, or unknown.

items.name: ResolverTool
items.prompt:
# Target
An offline, keccak-verifying selector resolver for this lane.
# Work
Write /fast/scratch/hyaku/kaidoku-r25a2/ResolverTool/resolve-selectors.py (Python 3, standard library only, pure-Python Keccak-256 adapted from /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/arc3-loop1-round1/claims/c1/RV-1/keccak_ref.py with attribution). Input: a REA inspect-evm-interface envelope JSON plus one or more saved database response files (4byte and openchain shapes). Output JSON per selector: candidates from each database, keccak check per candidate, and a label `verified-candidate` (keccak matches) or `rejected-mismatch`; never a single 'the name'. Include a --selftest with fixed vectors: keccak256('') = c5d2460186f7233c927e7db2dcc703c0e500b653ca82273b7bfad8045d85a470, transfer(address,uint256) -> a9059cbb, balanceOf(address) -> 70a08231, and a negative control showing hashlib.sha3_256('transfer(address,uint256)') does not give a9059cbb. Run the selftest and run it once on a real REA envelope from a retained carrier (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/arc3-loop1-round1/claims/c1/RV-2/Rv2Token.runtime.hex) with live database responses you fetch.
# Acceptance
Report the script path and sha256, the selftest output and exit code, the real run output, and limits.
